quest.title: Dragon Storm
quest.description: The usually peaceful Mondstadt was suddenly assailed by a dragon. This is the Stormterror that Amber spoke of, and was the gigantic creature that you encountered in the forest earlier.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Primogem x20, Mora x2400, Character EXP x1250, Fine Enhancement Ore x2

chapter.title: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #Kaeya, {NICKNAME}, you've come at the right time. We must...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hold on, Amber. Are you perhaps forgetting to introduce us?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh... right. This is Kaeya, our Cavalry Captain.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #These two are travelers from afar, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: (From afar? Is that all we know of them?)

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I see. Welcome to Mondstadt — though you haven't arrived at the best of times, I'm afraid.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I understand the anguish of being separated from family.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I'm not really sure why you're looking for the Anemo God...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But everyone has their secrets, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, relax! I won't press you for more.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: First and foremost, on behalf of the Knights of Favonius, I would like to extend our thanks to you for your help just now.

choices.text: Well, we couldn't just leave the situation to fester.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Your fight to defend the city against the dragon just now was witnessed by no small number of citizens.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius is also very interested in meeting you, and formally invites you both to <color=#00E1FFFF>our headquarters</color>.

choices.text: You're welcome! So... Ah... Where's the reward?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Ahh... How about a traditional Mondstadt delicacy, Sticky Honey Roast?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I just heard about that one!

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters
